source.kind: deterministic procedural YUV420; no movie pixels

encoder.input: rawvideo yuv420p 320x224, default rawvideo frame rate 25

method: Pixel entropy was selected before ordinary x264 encoding until the complete legal VCL RBSP was exactly 65536 bytes. No encoded header, residual, reference, filter flag, or trailing bits were patched.
scope: Controller RBSP capacity and coded/cropped geometry regression, not playback, source-DAR, hardware throughput, or full-AU transport-capacity qualification. Annex-B framing and emulation-prevention bytes are outside the RBSP byte count.
